data.long_meaning: Musyaffa is derived from the Arabic root word 'saffa' which means 'to purify', 'to clean', or 'to make something bright'. The name Musyaffa itself means 'gift', 'grace', or 'blessing'. This name is a beautiful reminder of the blessings and gifts that Allah (SWT) bestows upon us. The name Musyaffa carries the meaning “Gift, Grace, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Musyaffa usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, grace, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
